_comment: Hand-written 'build idea' per trending repo, merged into docs/data/trending.json by scripts/trending.mjs. Keep each idea to one sentence; public-safe.

morluto/rea.idea: Agent-driven teardown of legacy apps: recover lost business logic from binaries before a rewrite.

debpalash/VoiceStudio.idea: Local voice cloning for narrated tutorials and dubbing, with no per-minute fees.

stablyai/orca.idea: Run a fleet of coding agents side by side, one per ticket, and review the results in one place.

xerj-org/xerj.idea: One local binary that indexes code and docs, so every agent shares the same search over your knowledge.

anomalyco/opencode.idea: Open-source terminal coding agent you can point at any model for cost control.

storytold/artcraft.idea: Composable scenes for storyboards and ad concepts where artists keep control of every frame.

heygen-com/hyperframes.idea: Agents write HTML, the renderer outputs video: data-driven explainers and product clips at scale.

anthropics/claude-plugins-official.idea: Curated starting set of Claude Code plugins to standardise a team's agent setup.

NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra.idea: Pair with an agent for firmware audits of IoT devices and supply-chain checks.

Comfy-Org/ComfyUI.idea: Node-graph backend for repeatable image and video pipelines behind your own API.

K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills.idea: Give lab and analytics teams an agent that follows real scientific workflows.

tashfeenahmed/freellmapi.idea: One gateway across free model endpoints for prototypes, with paid models only where quality matters.

ruvnet/ruflo.idea: Multi-agent swarms for long tasks like research reports or migrations, coordinated from one harness.

akitaonrails/ai-memory.idea: Hand off context between coding CLIs so a task survives switching tools or machines.

LibreSpark/LibreTV.idea: Self-hosted video portal pattern; useful reference for private training-video libraries.

HKUDS/CLI-Anything.idea: Wrap desktop software in a CLI so agents can operate tools that have no API.

harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo.idea: Topic in, captioned short video out: the baseline any short-form pipeline should beat.

yt-dlp/yt-dlp.idea: Pull your own published videos back for repurposing, transcripts and archives.

shiyu-coder/Kronos.idea: Foundation model for market candles; use for research and education, never as signals.

chthollyphile/folia-major.idea: Lyric animation ideas for music visualisers and karaoke-style captions.

vectorize-io/hindsight.idea: Agent memory that learns from outcomes: support bots that stop repeating mistakes.

paperclipai/paperclip.idea: Workplace console to assign, budget and audit agents like team members.

affaan-m/ECC.idea: Tune an agent harness with skills, memory and security rules instead of prompt tweaks.

cloudflare/security-audit-skill.idea: Run a multi-phase security audit skill on every pull request before release.

lexmount/moli.idea: Lightweight headless browser for scraping and agent browsing at low memory cost.

rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch.idea: Structured curriculum to upskill a team from prompt users to AI engineers.

Panniantong/Agent-Reach.idea: Let an agent read social platforms and video sites for market and trend research.

pbakaus/impeccable.idea: A design language for agents so generated UIs look considered, not templated.

calesthio/OpenMontage.idea: Agentic video production with many pipelines: a reference for end-to-end content factories.

hydra-db/hydradb.idea: Graph database on object storage for cheap, large knowledge graphs behind agents.

NVIDIA/OpenShell.idea: Sandboxed runtime so autonomous agents can execute code without touching the host.

thedotmack/claude-mem.idea: Persistent session memory for coding agents, so project context carries over day to day.

mksglu/context-mode.idea: Shrink tool output before it hits the context window to cut cost on long agent runs.

dream-num/univer.idea: Spreadsheets, docs and slides an agent can edit directly: office automation without macros.

deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.idea: Plugin-first agent harness; compare against your current stack before committing.

NousResearch/hermes-agent.idea: Personal agent that accumulates skills over time; a model for assistant products.

tensorflow/tensorflow.idea: Mature training and serving stack for classic ML models on edge and mobile.

firecrawl/firecrawl.idea: Turn any website into clean markdown for RAG, price monitoring or lead research.

Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT.idea: Visual builder for always-on agents that watch inputs and act on triggers.

ollama/ollama.idea: Run open models locally for private drafting, tagging and summarising at zero marginal cost.

f/prompts.chat.idea: Seed a team prompt library, then keep only the prompts that prove themselves.

DietrichGebert/ponytail.idea: Push coding agents toward the smallest change that works, for cleaner pull requests.

huggingface/transformers.idea: Fine-tune a small model on your own documents when an API model is too costly or too generic.

langgenius/dify.idea: Self-hosted platform for RAG apps and agent workflows that non-engineers can edit.

open-webui/open-webui.idea: Private chat interface over local or hosted models for a whole team.

langflow-ai/langflow.idea: Drag-and-drop agent flows that can be exported as APIs.

langchain-ai/langchain.idea: Standard building blocks for agents, retrieval and tool calling across model vendors.

Graphify-Labs/graphify.idea: Turn a codebase and its docs into a queryable knowledge graph for onboarding.

shadcn-ui/ui.idea: Accessible component kit that agents can assemble into production-ready UIs.

microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners.idea: Free 21-lesson course to onboard non-engineers to generative AI.

browser-use/browser-use.idea: Agents that click through real websites: form filling, QA checks and portal automation.
